sources.summary: Spanish studio NUA Arquitectures has completed Casa Juià, a farmhouse in Catalonia that draws on the craftsmanship of the surrounding region. Located in the village of Juià, at the foot of the Gavarres mountain range in Spain, the 283-square-metre home comprises three parallel wings wrapped in porches and galleries. Casa Juià reinterprets the region's traditional farmhouse The post Catalan farmhouse designed as "a passage through the land" appeared first on Dezeen .
